sources.evidence: Card linked by the exact preview documentation; describes a multimodal reasoning model intended for high-volume, latency-sensitive tasks. Its architecture section explicitly directs readers to the Gemini 3 Pro card. Distribution is through Google products and APIs.

name.note: Official hyphenated Flash-Lite display name and exact preview identity.

developer.note: Google publishes this model; the model card is from Google DeepMind.

family.note: Normalized catalog family for the Flash-Lite branch of the Gemini 3 series, not a literal API identifier.

release_date.note: Explicit first public preview launch. May 7, 2026 is the separate stable endpoint release and must not replace it.

open_weights.note: Documented distribution is hosted API/product access under service terms; the reviewed distribution sources provide no downloadable weights.

license.note: Descriptive classification for the model accessed under Google service terms. Documentation copyright licenses are not model-weight licenses.

parameters_b.note: No total parameter count for the exact model was disclosed in the inspected cards, including later exact-name comparison material. Targeted first-party training/interpretability searches found no additional disclosure.

active_parameters_b.note: Sparse routing is documented, but its numerical active-parameter count is not. No sibling values or external estimates are substituted.

architecture.note: The exact preview documentation links the Flash-Lite card, whose architecture section explicitly delegates to Gemini 3 Pro. That linked card specifies a sparse MoE Transformer. Expert counts and dimensions are not disclosed.

context_window.note: Exact preview input-token limit. The separate output limit is 65,536. These are archived endpoint specifications, not evidence of present operation.

modalities.note: Exact preview documentation confirms five input categories and text output; PDF is a supported document input format.

reasoning.note: Thinking is explicitly supported by the preview capability table.

tool_call.note: Function calling is explicitly supported by the preview capability table.

patch.notes: Preview launched March 3, 2026 and shut down May 25, 2026; stable gemini-3.1-flash-lite launched May 7, 2026. Limits and capabilities describe the exact retired preview. Its linked model card explicitly delegates architecture to the sparse MoE Transformer Gemini 3 Pro card. Total and active parameter counts remain undisclosed in the inspected primary material.
patch.name: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite Preview

research_notes: Inspected the original Models.dev lead, exact preview docs, launch announcement, release notes, original HTML and May-updated PDF cards, explicit Pro architecture reference, and July/September/October later cards.

Searched the exact model name with parameters, total parameters, active parameters, architecture, transformer, interpretability, training research, sparse autoencoder and transcoder, including deepmind.google, research.google, storage.googleapis.com and arxiv.org. No first-party exact-model numerical parameter disclosure was located; this is a bounded search, not an exhaustive absence claim.
The July comparison names Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite without a preview identifier. It was checked for disclosures only; no later stable or successor capabilities were used to overwrite the preview specs.
summary: All 14 fields assessed. Add proprietary license and MoE architecture from explicit primary-card references, and replace the generic description with a preview-specific description noting its May 25 retirement. Confirm March 3 preview release, 1,048,576 input limit, multimodal inputs, reasoning and function calling. Total and active parameters remain undisclosed after later-card and targeted research checks.
